subject: Risk & Compliance
title: The Equifax Breach
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on The Equifax Breach.

hook.text: In 2017, hackers stole the personal data of 147 million Americans from Equifax. Names, SSNs, everything.

buildup.text: Equifax failed to patch a known vulnerability for two months. That was all the hackers needed.

discovery.text: The breach wasn't detected for 76 days. Attackers had free access to the most sensitive data in America.

twist.text: Equifax executives sold stock before the breach was announced. Several faced insider trading investigations.

climax.text: Equifax settled for $700 million but continued operating. No one went to prison for the negligence.

punchline.text: 147 million records stolen. $700M fine. No jail time.

quiz.question: What caused the Equifax breach?
options: An unpatched known vulnerability left open for months
An insider intentionally leaked the data
